title: Mega Man X3 - The Catfish-Disguised Tanuki 🍃 ~ Volt Catfish's Stage (Futatsuiwa-Mix)
description:
❝𝐀𝐢𝐧’𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐲 𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨
𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐥𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐧 ‘𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐰𝐨 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐭?❞
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- Mamizou Futatsuiwa, 2013 🍃

Did an arrangement of Volt Catfish's Stage from Mega Man X3, fused with Mamizou Futatsuiwa's theme from Touhou 13, Futatsuiwa from Sado. Decided to do this because of a friend telling me this song is just edgy hot cross buns, and it ruined my entire perception of it. Also, it's been a while since I did an X series theme, and I'm always up for doing some more Touhou X Mega Man mashups.

Volt Catfish's theme is pretty cool. Always been a fan of it ever since I first heard it in a Sonic romhack over a decade ago.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. D# Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C Minor (Futatsuiwa from Gensokyo Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. E Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
